title: Lesson 38 · Everything except the weather
titleZh: 第38课 唯独没有考虑到天气

examples.zh: 他什么都考虑到了，唯独没有考虑到天气。

article.en: My old friend had lived in the Mediterranean for many years before he returned to England.
article.zh: 我的老朋友在回到英国之前，曾在地中海地区生活多年。

article.en: He had often dreamed of retiring in England.
article.zh: 他过去常梦想退休后回英国定居。

article.en: He had also planned to settle down in the country.
He had no sooner returned than he bought a house and went to live there.
article.zh: 他一回来就买了一幢房子，住了进去。

article.en: Almost immediately he began to complain about the weather.
article.zh: 几乎马上他就开始抱怨天气了。

article.en: Even though it was still summer, it rained continually and it was often bitterly cold.
article.zh: 虽然仍是夏天，但雨总是下个不停，而且常常冷得厉害。

article.en: After so many years of sunshine, Harrison got a shock.
article.zh: 在阳光下生活了这么多年，哈里森感到震惊。

article.en: In the end, it was more than he could bear.
article.zh: 最后，他实在忍受不了了。

article.en: He had hardly had time to settle down when he sold the house and left the country.
article.zh: 他还没来得及安顿下来，就卖掉了房子，离开了这个国家。

article.en: He had thought of everything except the weather.
article.zh: 他什么都考虑到了，唯独没有考虑到天气。
